doc.title: Joe Bushkin interviewed by Monk Rowe, Los Angeles, California, February 15, 1999

title: Closing remarks and Joe Anderson
summary: Thanks, goodbyes and plans to call and send a video to Joe Anderson.

story.theme_name: Thanks and goodbyes: closing the interview
story.community_name: Closing thanks and goodbyes at the end of the interview

blocks.x: Right. Well you know you’ve had just the longest, most productive career, and it’s been a great pleasure talking to you.
Out here in Los Angeles. So I appreciate your time, and bringing these CD’s for me to listen to back at the college.
Well I most appreciate it. I’m sure our students will get a lot out of —
Say hello to all the jazz fans at Hamilton. Because they were just the greatest. And I’ve got Joe Anderson’s Vermont phone number, that’s where he’s living these days.
And I’ve got his phone number, I’ve got to give him a call and tell him we were together.
In fact I think I’ll send him a copy of this video.
Oh he’d love to have it, I’m sure.
Okay Monk, all the best. © Hamilton College Jazz Archive -21-
